This discussion may contain forward-looking statements that anticipate results that are subject to uncertainty. We discuss in more detail various factors that could cause actual results to differ from expectations in Part I, Item 1A, Risk Factors in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. For further discussion regarding our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, refer to Part II, Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations , in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 . Recent Developments 2026 Financial Guidance In 2026, we will focus on pricing in excess of cost inflation, driving profitable volume growth, investing in sustainability to improve the environment and drive growth, investing in value-creating acquisitions and advancing technology to improve productivity and increase customer retention. Specific guidance follows: Revenue We expect revenue to be in the range of $17.050 billion to $17.150 billion. We expect growth from average yield on total revenue to be in a range of 3.2% to 3.7% and related revenue to be in a range of 4.0% to 4.5%. We expect the impact from volume on total revenue to be approximately (1.0)%. Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share The following is a summary of anticipated adjusted diluted earnings per share for the year ending December 31, 2026 compared to the actual adjusted diluted earnings per share for the year ended December 31, 2025. Our definition of adjusted diluted earnings per share may not be comparable to similarly titled measures presented by other companies. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds capital spending plus shareholder distributions, so the business funds its reinvestment and return programme internally. Free cash flow covers dividends and buybacks with room to spare, a hallmark of a waste-services franchise with contracted, recurring collection revenue and pricing power.

Operating margin sits well above the Industrials sector median, reflecting disciplined pricing in excess of cost inflation and the density economics of vertically integrated landfill and collection assets. This margin cushion is the primary buffer protecting cash flow through volume softness.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage both sit above the sector median and drifted modestly higher year over year, so the balance sheet carries more debt than peers for a comparable asset base. The indicative profile is Intermediate, with limited headroom before the next leverage band.

Disclosure flags substantial indebtedness as a constraint on obtaining financing on acceptable terms and on operating within financing covenant limits. Combined with sensitivity to recycled commodity prices, fuel, interest rates and the ability to pass through cost inflation, this is the central credit vulnerability.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains solidly above one but has slipped year over year and trails the sector median, indicating earnings absorb interest comfortably yet with less cushion than peers. Coverage is the tightest of the servicing metrics and warrants monitoring as rates reset.

Cash flow to debt improved year over year but remains below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is likewise weaker than peers. Debt service is nonetheless supported by recurring operating cash flow, with maturities spread across the profile rather than concentrated in any single year.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer is a large, cash-generative environmental services platform with recurring revenue, superior operating margins and self-funding capital returns. Leverage above the sector median and coverage below it temper the profile, leaving an indicative Intermediate risk assessment rather than a stronger standing.

Our judgement is a stable but not improving trajectory: management guides to pricing-led revenue growth with modest volume decline, which should sustain cash flow. A current ratio well below peers and one signals reliance on revolving liquidity, so refinancing access remains the key swing factor for the view.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流穩健地超過資本開支加股東分派，因此業務以內部資源支持其再投資及回報計劃。自由現金流足以覆蓋股息及回購並有餘裕，此乃擁有合約式經常性收集收入及定價能力的廢物處理服務特許經營之標誌。
營運利潤率遠高於工業行業中位數，反映定價紀律嚴謹、加價幅度超過成本通脹，以及垂直整合的堆填及收集資產所帶來的密度經濟效益。此利潤率緩衝是保護現金流渡過成交量疲弱的主要屏障。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿均高於行業中位數，並按年溫和上升，因此相對於可比較的資產基礎，資產負債表所承擔的債務較同業為多。指示性評估為中等，距離下一個槓桿區間僅有有限空間。
披露文件指出，重大負債構成以可接受條款取得融資以及於融資契約限制內營運的制約。加上對回收商品價格、燃料、利率及轉嫁成本通脹能力的敏感度，此乃核心信用弱點。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率穩健地高於一倍，但按年下滑並落後於行業中位數，顯示盈利可舒適地吸收利息，惟緩衝較同業為少。覆蓋率是各項償債指標中最為緊絀的一項，隨著利率重訂值得監察。
現金流對債務比率按年改善，但仍低於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率亦較同業為弱。儘管如此，償債仍獲經常性營運現金流支持，到期債務分佈於整個期間，而非集中於任何單一年度。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人為大型、現金生成能力強的環境服務平台，擁有經常性收入、優越的營運利潤率及自我融資的資本回報。槓桿高於行業中位數而覆蓋率低於中位數，令整體狀況受到抑制，因而得出指示性中等風險評估，而非更強的地位。
我們的判斷是走勢穩定但並非改善：管理層指引以定價帶動收入增長，成交量輕微下降，應可維持現金流。流動比率遠低於同業及低於一倍，顯示依賴循環流動性，因此再融資渠道仍是影響觀點的關鍵變數。
